title: Citrullination in proteins of the polycomb repressor complex 1.
authors: Alvarez-Rodriguez, Maria Gabriela; Capone, Emanuel; Vega, Sonia; Rejas, Virginia; Rizzuti, Bruno; Velazquez-Campoy, Adrian; Neira, Jose L
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PADI4酶与RING1B/RYBP肽段的瓜氨酸化结合，虽涉及分子对接，但核心是酶-肽互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: The Polycomb repressive complexes can be considered a paradigm of chromatin-based gene regulation in animals. Two of the proteins involved in such complexes are the Ring finger protein 1 (RING1) and the intrinsically disordered protein RING1A and YY1 binding protein (RYBP), which binds to RING1 in some of the Polycomb complexes. Peptidyl arginine iminohydrolases (PADIs) are enzymes involved in the post-translational modification of arginine to citrulline. PADI4, one of the five isoforms of PADI in humans, citrullinates RING1B and RYBP at specific arginines at their C-terminal (Arg231) and N-terminal (Arg53) regions, respectively. In this work, we studied in vitro and in silico whether isolated peptides from each protein, encompassing those wild-type arginines and their citrulline-modified counterparts, were capable of binding to PADI4. The isolated peptides, either in wild-type or modified form, were monomeric and disordered as indicated by far-UV CD and NMR. The affinity constants of peptides for PADI4, as measured by fluorescence, biolayer interferometry (BLI) and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC), were in the low micromolar range (dissociation constants around 10-20 muM), and the affinities were smaller for the citrullinated variants. Molecular docking simulations showed that the isolated peptides from each protein, either in wild-type form or modified variants, targeted the active site of PADI4, corresponding to the catalytic residue Cys645. These findings suggest that the isolated peptides were capable of binding to the enzyme with affinities similar to those of intact RING1B or RYBP, and that citrullination of the arginines diminished the affinity for the enzyme.
abstract_zh: Polycomb抑制复合物可被视为动物中基于染色质的基因调控的范式。参与此类复合物的两种蛋白质是环指蛋白1（RING1）和 intrinsically disordered protein RING1A and YY1 binding protein (RYBP)，后者在某些Polycomb复合物中与RING1结合。肽基精氨酸亚氨基水解酶（PADIs）是参与精氨酸转化为瓜氨酸的翻译后修饰的酶。PADI4是人体中PADI的五种亚型之一，分别在RING1B和RYBP的C端（Arg231）和N端（Arg53）区域对特定精氨酸进行瓜氨酸化。在本工作中，我们通过体外和计算机模拟研究了来自每种蛋白质的分离肽段（涵盖这些野生型精氨酸及其瓜氨酸修饰对应物）是否能够与PADI4结合。分离肽段，无论是野生型还是修饰形式，均呈单体且无序，如远紫外圆二色谱（far-UV CD）和核磁共振（NMR）所示。通过荧光、生物层干涉法（BLI）和等温滴定量热法（ITC）测量的肽段对PADI4的亲和常数处于低微摩尔范围（解离常数约为10-20 μM），且瓜氨酸化变体的亲和力较小。分子对接模拟显示，来自每种蛋白质的分离肽段，无论是野生型还是修饰变体，均靶向PADI4的活性位点，对应于催化残基Cys645。这些发现表明，分离肽段能够以与完整RING1B或RYBP相似的亲和力结合酶，且精氨酸的瓜氨酸化降低了与酶的亲和力。
